III. Reading Passage. (Đọc đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất)

Music and Arts in School

Music and arts are very important in schools. Students often take part in performances such as singing, dancing, and playing instruments. Many students like painting and photography because they are creative activities.

Schools also organize art exhibitions and music festivals. Students compare different performances and choose what they like best. Music and arts help students express feelings and relax after school. They also make school life more enjoyable.

Mini Review / Ôn Tập Nhanh

Key Vocabulary / Từ vựng cốt lõi

  • 🎨 exhibition (cuộc triển lãm)
  • 🎭 performance (buổi trình diễn)
  • 📸 photography (nhiếp ảnh)

Grammar Rules / Cấu trúc ngữ pháp

  • ✨ S + prefer + Noun + to + Noun (Thích cái gì hơn cái gì)
  • ✨ S + be + as + Adj + as + Noun (So sánh ngang bằng)
  • ✨ S + be + different from + Noun (Khác với cái gì)
